label: Left Patch
description: A left patch breast pocket sewn onto the outside of the waistcoat front, the most casual and visible pocket style. Its applied, outlined shape adds texture and a relaxed, sporty character, common on tweed and odd waistcoats. The patch pocket signals informality and country tailoring.
